science_vegetable: Magnetohydrodynamic Kelvin-Helmholtz shear across the ferrofluid sea

master_narrator.agency_handoff_prompt: Hector braces against the whistling wind, turning to spot Kaio scrambling up the scaffolding. 'Catch!' he yells, throwing the heavy brass baton over the churning black sea. Over to you, Kaio.
